---
title: Architecture decisions
---

Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) explain choices that affect the long-term
structure, security, compatibility, or maintenance of NADABAS.

## Records

- [ADR 0001: Maintain technical documentation with Quarto](0001-documentation-platform.qmd)

## Adding a decision

Create a numbered record when a decision has meaningful alternatives or lasting
consequences. Include context, the decision, consequences, alternatives, status,
and date. Later decisions should supersede older records rather than rewriting
their history.
